title: ManualControl
description: Operator stick input, on ark/<droneId>/manual at about 10 Hz (QoS 0, not acked, like an RC link). Body-frame velocity and yaw-rate requests; the drone clamps them and holds position if packets stop for 1 s.

seq.description: Increments per packet; the drone drops stale or reordered ones.

yawRateDegS.description: Clockwise seen from above is positive.
